description: This file defines the 'Popup_Picker' class responsible for handling pop-up selection interfaces for contacts within the SuiteCRM modules. It includes methods for generating contact lists, processing address-related pages, and handling merge operations, demonstrating tightly coupled functionality specific to contact selection.

classes.name: Popup_Picker
classes.description: Handles popup-based contact selection, address processing, and merge functionalities for the Contacts module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs an SQL WHERE clause based on request parameters for filtering contacts.

methods.name: process_page_for_address
methods.description: Generates and displays a contact address selection popup page, with address copying and form handling features.

methods.name: process_page_for_merge
methods.description: Creates a popup interface for selecting contacts to include in a merge operation, supporting multi-select and filtering.
